name: TraderWAI
description: Hosted MCP server that connects AI clients to live charts and the user's own trading account: read charts for 40 symbols (forex, metals, indices, energy, futures, crypto; M1 to monthly), draw analysis on the chart, backtest rule-based strategies on 1-minute history, and place and manage orders with risk-based position sizing and conditional orders on MetaTrader 4/5, cTrader, TradeLocker, Match-Trader, DXtrade (beta), Capital.com (beta), Binance and Bybit. OAuth sign-in; free plan with unlimited charts and analysis and 5 order executions per day, paid plans for more.
author: TraderWAI
